intro_street.desc: Street intro score (20 s, 120 BPM, D hijaz): pencil scratches with a climbing qanun, watercolour shimmer, maqsum darbuka chase with footsteps, letter marimba run, boings, ring run, overshoot gag, pops and bulb ding, book flap, match hit and sting. Synced to remotion/src/intro/street.json.
